name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 8 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 50 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2025-05-01, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.93 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
